operatorPhases.clockRequirement: Marker monotonic clock must use the same host and boot as sampler

limitations: Only the explicitly selected main PID is measured; WebKit, GPU, provider and other helper processes are excluded.
No GPU utilization, energy, battery, thermal, total application footprint or UI responsiveness is measured.
RSS is resident memory, not a leak diagnosis. CPU is interval task CPU time / monotonic elapsed time; 100% means one core.
Disk scans are metadata-only, bounded and non-atomic while the app writes; allocated blocks may be shared on APFS.
Manifest fields describe a sampled publication, not independent chain/numerical verification or proof of hardware crash durability.
The sampler adds measurement overhead; missing metrics and incomplete scans remain explicit.

limits: Load exclusion is a descriptive sensitivity analysis; thermal/caching effects may persist and unrecorded host work remains unknown.
Never delete a functional stall or missing measurement when excluding resource-load samples.
Marker state is operator-declared; no continuous window-state instrumentation or independent GPU attribution.
Wall-clock-to-load matching is uncertain if base coverage records wall-clock jumps; review those before interpreting excluded summaries.
Observed-Start marker follows the UI action and is a conservative time origin, not an exact HTTP or numerical admission timestamp.
Incomplete early/late windows retain partial statistics for inspection only and cannot satisfy the prospective comparison.
